question: What is the upper limit and subdivision of the two-storeyed ābhāsa type?
premises: The range extends up to eleven or twelve units.
The type is the two-storeyed ābhāsa.
It is divided into eight forms.
inference: The two-storeyed ābhāsa type extends up to eleven or twelve and is eightfold.
uncertainties: The exact numerical values of rudra and bhānu in this context follow conventional symbolic usage.
plain_english: The two-storeyed ābhāsa, extending up to eleven or twelve, is divided into eight forms.
